de.abas.eks.jfop

Class FOPExitException

  • Object
    • Throwable
      • Exception
        • RuntimeException
          • FOPExitException
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class FOPExitException
extends RuntimeException
    If this RuntimeException is thrown in a JFOP, the FO command .error is called with the message and the JFOPs exits with the exit code specified in the constructor. No stacktrace of the Exception is displayed.
